title: Someone's putting up missing posters with my face. They say I disappear tonight at 11:40.
transcript:
Someone's putting up missing posters with my face. They say I disappear tonight at 11:40. The first one was taped to the bus stop outside my building. My name. My face. Last seen tonight, eleven forty.

The photo was wrong. Me, sitting somewhere dark, looking straight up, mouth open like I was about to scream. I've never seen that picture in my life.

I tore it down. There was another on the next pole. And the next. A trail of them, all the way to my front door.

At eleven thirty, my phone buzzed. A text from my own number. "Lock the door. Kill the lights. Don't let me in."

So I did. I sat on the kitchen floor in the dark and watched the clock on the stove. Eleven thirty-eight. Eleven thirty-nine.

At eleven forty, the doorknob turned. Then my own voice came through the door, out of breath. "Please. It's me. It's out here with me. Let me in."

I didn't move. I pressed my back against the cabinets and stared up at the ceiling, trying not to breathe.

That's when I understood the photo. The dark. Looking straight up. My mouth open.

Right above me, a camera flashed.
